ANNEXURE - II
(ADVERTISEMENT)
GAUTAM BUDDHA UNIVERSITY
SCHOOL/DEPARTMENT/CENTRE Advt.
Applications are invited for the following purely temporary post(s) in the CSIR project entitled
“Development of pan drug resistant Candida Auris Prototype in Saccharomyces cerevisiae through synthetic
biology”
• Jr. Research Fellow (JRF): Salary/Scale Rs.37,000/-p.m./- (plus HRA)
• Essential Qualifications: MSc (Biotechnology, Microbiology or allied areas, Bioinformatics) min 55% B.S. 4
years programme/Integrated BSMS/MSc/BE/BTech or equivalent degree, with 55% marks and passing of
NET/GATE test. (CSIR-HRDG website: www.csirhrdg.res.in)
• Desirable Qualifications: M i crobiology, GE, computational biology, Genomics and transcriptomics
• Job Requirements : Complete the proposed objectives of project
• Upper Age limit:28 years
The Project is valid for a period till Oct 2027. The selected candidate(s) will be appointed on purely
temporary basis initially for a period of one year or till the services are required by the Principal Investigator or
till the validity of the project, whichever is earliest.
The application on plain paper indicating name, date of birth / age/ address/contact no. and email/ essential /
technical / professional qualifications, experience, research work, list of published books / articles and related
information should reach to, rpuria@gbu.ac.in, Principal Investigator, Rekha Puria School of Biotechnology,
Gautam Buddha University, Greater Noida - 201312, on or before 20th Feb 2026.
(Rekha Puria, )
